QUOTE: It is triggered only from the failed-post bottom sheet, where the user taps "Try Again" (`post.failed.retry`, `app/components/post_list/post/body/failed/index.tsx:38-65`). Tapping "Delete Message" calls `removePost` instead.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says retry occurs only when the user taps "Try Again" on the failed post and names `retryFailedPost` as the function that handles it.
